acceptance: Exact horizon-row/factorization and null witnesses with direct trajectory comparison.
Robust panel compared against exhaustive subsets under identical costs and uncertainty.
Source-bound archive pilot with frozen target/horizon and no synthetic-to-empirical claim transfer.

acceptance: Replay the rational position/driver example and constrained-state case.
Direct powers through horizon eight agree; retained witnesses prove infeasibility.

acceptance: Enumerate at most 4096 panels and compare exact optimizer.
Retain equal-rank/different-conditioning and strict noise-boundary cases.

pushes.title: Frozen provenance-bound forecast pilot
acceptance: Recover actual source manifests and independently measured target truth.

title: Nonlinear ambiguity witnesses
summary: Construct exact same-observation/different-target states and distinguish local tangent tests from complete fibre constancy. Include the constraint-curvature correction to second variations on curved observation fibres.
acceptance: Exact affine-quadratic constancy criterion and independent witness replay.
Parabola regression confirms corrected Hessian; disconnected branches invalidate local-to-global inference.
Bounded sensor repair clearly distinguishes finite witness coverage from complete fibre separation.

pushes.title: Exact affine-fibre constancy and witnesses
acceptance: Verify both quadratic coefficient conditions by substitution.
Keep gap lower bounds distinct from complete diameter certificates.

pushes.title: Curvature-aware local fibre analysis
acceptance: Parabola target curvature equals two despite zero ambient target Hessian.
Independent parametrizations agree at regular stationary points; singular cases are refused.

pushes.title: Bounded nonlinear sensor repair
acceptance: At most four variables and degree four; exact or validated witnesses.
Retain a branch ambiguity missed by finite witness coverage.

title: Target-preserving multiscale transport
summary: Certify coarse/fine commutation defects and propagate them into target-specific horizon errors. Exact closure of a mass target must be distinguished from approximate closure of coarse spatial averages.
acceptance: Four-cell rational diffusion example reproduces defect (-1/32,1/32).
Finite-horizon bounds validated against direct trajectories and box vertices under justified linear hypotheses.
Real-data-facing scale transfer keeps model/reference/measurement and target representation errors separate.

pushes.title: Exact scale-transfer algebra
acceptance: Independent cell-flux update reproduces every displayed fraction.
One-dimensional mass target closes while pair averages fail to close.

pushes.title: Certified scale-error transport and enrichment
acceptance: Bounded-domain and correlated-domain errors maintain declared norms.
One added target-relevant coordinate improves a retained valid bound.

pushes.title: One provenance-bound physical scale pilot
acceptance: Recover existing manifest or anonymous primary benchmark.
Freeze scalar target and report numerical-reference and measurement agreement separately.

title: Reactive transport observability
summary: Build conservative rational transport/reaction toys and prove that accurate total concentration can leave species targets structurally invisible. Design species/location/time readings before any empirical chemistry claim.
acceptance: Independent reaction/flux update and positive conservation verify the four-state toy.
All-time total-observation blindness and species target gap (3/4)^T are exact.
Frozen sourced pilot never substitutes simulated latent species for independent target truth.

pushes.title: Conservative toy and structural blindness
acceptance: Verify HM=DH and all simplex-vertex mass balances.
Species-selective repair separates the retained same-total initial states.

pushes.title: Costed species/location/time panel
acceptance: At most twelve experiments; exhaustive panel oracle.
Uncertain-rate case demonstrates nominal-rank recovery can fail robust separation.

pushes.title: Provenance-bound reaction/measurement pilot
acceptance: Acquire one primary anonymous source with units and method metadata.
Freeze mechanism/domain and separate validation residuals from physical model error claims.

title: Identifiable movement-test design

acceptance: Three-condition null witness and determinant-one fourth-condition repair replay exactly.
Target-specific robust repair compared with exhaustive catalogue subsets.
Frozen chronological/player-held-out pilot validates identity namespaces and reports matched-sample negative outcomes.

Separate structural new-condition gains from repetitions under an explicit dependence model.

Predeclare outcome and split; no athlete leakage across linked attempts.

title: Ordered movement signatures

acceptance: Axis-order paths have equal endpoints and opposite unit oriented areas under independent integration.
Segmentation compression preserves original identities and multiplicities and refuses unsafe current-summary merging.
Matched-channel order-insensitive and ordered baselines evaluated on identical held-out athletes.

acceptance: Streaming and direct segment integration agree.
